title: Easy trail 35min (Presolana, amber)
terrain: Valley or forest road, flattest available, hike anything steep
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 35min at 135-148bpm on the flattest terrain available, hike every climb, walk steep descents.
GYM: 10min mobility (quads, calves, hips).
FUEL: normal, refuel well for Monday.
GARMIN: ~30.
STOP RULE: HR over 150 on flat or quads sore = walk, cap 25min.
WHY: HRV 78 to 55 overnight (amber) and feel 5 after Sat: flush only.
